subject: Request: one-off goodwill package for Acme Inc. after regional latency degradation
messages:
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acmeinc.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Inc. Technical Ops <ops@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:22:14 -0700
Subject: High latency / timeouts 2027-05-09 to 05-10 (us-west) - request for remediation and credit

Hi Vivek,

We're seeing a sustained increase in 95th/99th percentile inference latency from ~80ms to peaks around 1.1s across several production endpoints in us-west starting late on May 9 through early May 10. This caused intermittent request timeouts for our customer-facing features and triggered failover behavior that impacted UX.

We've attached a short screenshot from our monitoring and the Ops ticket (OPS-3245). Can you confirm root cause and whether Redwood will provide a remediation gesture (credit or equivalent)? Our contract references an availability SLA with remedies for outages/latency degradations.

Appreciate quick acknowledgment — we have a renewal review scheduled for June and this is top of mind.

Thanks,
Sarah Johnson
Head of Platform
Acme Inc.

Attachments: screenshot_ops_ticket.png

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:04:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency / timeouts 2027-05-09 to 05-10 (us-west) - request for remediation and credit

Hi Sarah — thanks for flagging and for the details.

I'm sorry to hear this impacted your production flow. I've looped in Ben (account exec) and Marissa (VP) to help coordinate remediation and a goodwill proposal while engineering completes the incident RCA.

Can you attach the API request ids or traces you mentioned in the monitoring screenshot when you have a moment? That will speed matching on our side. We'll aim to come back with a proposed remediation package by next week.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:37:21 -07:00
Subject: Internal: proposed goodwill package for Acme (ops impact May 9-10)

Team,

Engineering (copied separately) has confirmed a transient network fabric misconfiguration in us-west that increased tail latency for a 3-hour window on May 9. The customer saw retries and some timed-out requests. Root cause and mitigation steps are in OPS-3245.

Customer health: strategic account, renewal due 2027-06-15, committed spend ~$150k/month, high potential upsell. Risk of churn if we mishandle this.

Options I've modelled (impact to ARR / precedent):
- Option A (conservative): Apply a $10k credit + offer 30 days of free premium support (no contract change).
- Option B (negotiated): Apply a $20k one-off credit, plus 1-month free Dedicated capacity (customer keeps same committed tier).
- Option C (aggressive): Apply a $30k credit and extend notice period in the renewal (hard to justify without product concession).

My recommendation is Option B: $20k credit + one free month. It balances recognition of impact with retention economics. Attached a short spreadsheet (proposed_goodwill_offer.xlsx) with math. Per policy, anything > $10k needs exec signoff.

Can we route to Vivek for final signoff today or tomorrow so finance can prepare the amendment and invoice offset?

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_goodwill_offer.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:56:49 -07:00
Subject: RE: Internal: proposed goodwill package for Acme (ops impact May 9-10)

Folks —

I agree with Ben's recommendation (Option B). A few notes for the approval record:
- Impact summary: customer experienced 3h of elevated p99 latency; quantifiable revenue impact is low but trust/relationship impact is significant.
- Policy: Sales/AM can approve up to $10k in credits; >$10k requires VP or above signoff and Finance notification.
- Proposed language for the amendment: "Redwood will apply a one-time credit of $20,000 to the June 2027 invoice and provide one complimentary month of Dedicated capacity support. This gesture is not an admission of liability and is provided as a goodwill accommodation."

Attached: latency_report_may10-12.pdf (engineering RCA snapshot).

Requesting Vivek to sign off by EOD Friday 2027-05-21 to meet finance cutoffs for June invoicing. If approved, I'll loop Legal to prepare a short amendment and Finance to apply the credit. If you want to lower the amount, please reply with a counter.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: latency_report_may10-12.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: one-time credit and support month for Acme Inc. (May latency event)

Sarah —

Thank you for your patience while we completed the RCA. I reviewed the engineering findings and Marissa/Ben's recommendation. To preserve the relationship and reduce renewal risk, Redwood will provide the following one-time accommodation:

- A one-off credit of $20,000 to be applied against Acme Inc.'s June 2027 invoice; and
- One complimentary month of Dedicated capacity support (applied to the next billing cycle).

This gesture is provided as a goodwill accommodation and is not an admission of liability. Finance and Legal are copied to process the credit and prepare a brief amendment. Laura — please confirm the finance steps and expected timeline for posting the credit.

Ben/Marissa — please let me know if you'd like me to send a short note to the renewal committee with this outcome.

Sarah — we'll also share a short postmortem and the mitigation timeline; engineering has implemented the fix and OPS-3245 will be closed once you sign off on the acceptance test.

Appreciate the partnership,

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Forwarded-to-Finance: Vivek Kulkarni (approved $20,000 credit + 1 month support); please create credit memo CM-ACME-0521 and notify billing team.
